headline: Vault-climbers strip unblocked after 2 silent bugs; Nervous System rewired for real visitors; inline style contract enforced across vault-climbers HTML.

items.title: Vault Climbers RLS + rank_name bugs fixed
items.insight: The vault-climbers strip wired in S201 showed nothing on the homepage because the anon Supabase key returns HTTP 200 with an empty array when RLS blocks — a silent failure, not a 400. Switching to the service role key via the CANON-012 secrets gateway immediately returned 5 real climbers. A second independent bug — querying a non-existent `rank_name` column — was fixed in both the build script and vault-rank-bar.js. On Windows, the dynamic ESM import of the secrets gateway required wrapping the path with `pathToFileURL()` from node:url.
items.evidence: api/rank-climbers.json has 5 real climbers: VaultSpark (100169pts), vaulteternalqa (1000pts), OneKingdom/Voidfall/DreadSpike (575-601pts)

items.title: Nervous System page rewritten for visitors
items.insight: The /nervous-system/ page was displaying raw session-agent notes as its 'What we shipped' copy — e.g. 'S202 #3 vault-climbers-rls-fix: scripts/build-rank-climbers.mjs — switched from hardcoded anon key'. Visitors saw dev jargon with no context. build-nervous-system.mjs was rewritten with stripDevTalk(), humanVerdict(), humanSurface() translation functions, and the 'Source contracts' panel (raw API file paths) was removed entirely. PROJECT_STATUS.json gained publicNote/publicNextStep fields that are preferred when set.
items.evidence: api/nervous-system.json now renders plain English; build-nervous-system.mjs --check passes

items.title: Vault-climbers inline style contract fix
items.insight: The vault-climbers strip shipped in S201 with 6 inline style attributes on index.html, violating check-intelligence-style-contract which monitors index.html as an HTML_TARGET. Extracted all inline styles to CSS classes in assets/style.css (#vault-climbers-strip, #vault-climbers-inner, .vc-label, .vc-period, .vc-ranks-link) and updated the HTML. Shell rebuild required after CSS change.
